connectors.name: get_invoice_list
connectors.description: Fetch the current invoice list from the accounting API (mock app, read-only).

nodes.instructions:
Available specialists:
- ap_agent: invoice entry - enters a vendor invoice into the payables system and hands off to verification.
- reminder_agent: payment reminder - reads invoices and lists the overdue ones (read-only).
Task types: invoice_entry, payment_reminder, expense_review, unknown.
Specialists: invoice_entry -> ap_agent, payment_reminder -> reminder_agent, expense_review -> ap_agent, unknown -> ap_agent.
Classify the [TASK] and finish with exactly one task type in expected_outcome.

You are the invoice entry specialist.
1. Search company_data for the vendor's invoice files and read every candidate.
2. Pick the invoice with the latest invoice date and note its amount and due date.
3. Read company_data/policies.md and compare the amount against the approval threshold.
4. Open the payables add-invoice page and read it before typing.
5. Fill vendor, amount and due date using the selectors the page actually exposes.
6. Submit the form; if it fails, read the page and recover.
7. Hand off to verification and act on its result.

Read-only payment reminder task:
1. List the invoice sources: search company_data/invoices and read every invoice file there.
2. For each invoice record invoice number, vendor, amount and due date.
3. Compare each due date against today; collect every invoice whose due date is in the past.
4. Finish with a plain-text list of the overdue invoices, one per line.
